Publication.title: Publication
Publication.description: One immutable release of one ontology, including its metadata, artifacts and dependencies. Package, publication and release refer to the same entity.

name.title: name
name.description: Short catalog identifier, qualified by namespace. The namespace/name pair identifies the same ontology across releases. URLs must not be derived from this identifier.

description.title: description
description.description: Short description of the ontology's domain and intended use.

schema_version.title: schema_version
schema_version.description: Metadata contract revision, independent of the ontology's version.

version.title: version
version.description: Complete publication version label, including amendments.

namespace_iri.title: namespace_iri
namespace_iri.description: Optional preferred primary RDF term namespace. Preserve the complete value including any trailing delimiter. Not the catalog namespace and not necessarily the ontology IRI.

publisher.title: publisher
publisher.description: Name of the upstream person or organization responsible for publishing the ontology. Not inferred from catalog namespace.

keywords.title: keywords
keywords.description: Keywords describing the ontology's subject. An empty list means no keywords are provided.

dependencies.title: dependencies
dependencies.description: Complete set of direct and indirect runtime dependency publications, excluding this publication. Each base_url occurs once. An empty list means this publication has no runtime dependencies.

published_at.title: published_at
published_at.description: First successful Hub publication time for this immutable release. Backend emits UTC date-time text with Z. Consumers accept timezone-bearing RFC 3339 text. Fixed for the lifetime of this publication. Not an upstream release date.

namespace.title: namespace
namespace.description: Namespace qualifying the ontology name, such as w3c in w3c/prov-o.

licenses.title: licenses
licenses.description: Reported license names or standard identifiers such as Apache-2.0. Empty means no information supplied. The list specifies neither AND nor OR combination semantics.

artifacts.title: artifacts
artifacts.description: Available artifacts of this ontology. Each artifact URL occurs once. Multiple artifacts may share a format.

preferred_prefix.title: preferred_prefix
preferred_prefix.description: Optional abbreviation for namespace_iri, without whitespace or a colon. Requires namespace_iri. This constraint does not certify prefix syntax for every ontology language.

base_url.title: base_url
base_url.description: Permanent absolute URL identifying one exact immutable publication. GET this exact URL returns its publication JSON. Do not append a filename.

Artifact.title: Artifact
Artifact.description: Ontology content in a declared format, with explicitly identified entry files.

format.title: format
format.description: Ontology language and syntax of the artifact.

url.title: url
url.description: Permanent absolute download URL of an immutable ontology file.

size_bytes.title: size_bytes
size_bytes.description: Byte length of the final immutable artifact file, before HTTP content encoding. Measured from the same bytes as sha256.

roots.title: roots
roots.description: Permanent absolute URLs of the entry files from which this artifact's ontology is loaded.

sha256.title: sha256
sha256.description: SHA-256 of the final immutable file bytes, before HTTP content encoding, as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

Dependency.title: Dependency
Dependency.description: A reference to an exact immutable publication required by this publication.

base_url.title: base_url
base_url.description: Permanent absolute URL identifying one exact immutable publication. GET this exact URL returns its publication JSON. Do not append a filename.

Format.title: Format
Format.description: A combination of ontology language and syntax.

title: Publication metadata
description: Metadata for one immutable ontology release, its artifacts and its dependencies.
